tagline: Putting customers first to deliver reliable, affordable power
hero_kpi_rationale: Massive capex in transmission infrastructure is the primary growth driver, fueled by rising demand from AI data centers and large industrial customers.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Amount invested annually in electrical infrastructure, such as transmission lines.
kpis.description: AEP is investing heavily to modernize its grid and meet growing demand from data centers.
kpis.signal: Capex rising sharply, supported by demand from AI data centers.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: Headcount remains high but stable, reflecting recent rationalization.
kpis.signal: Headcount stable following a voluntary separation program in 2024.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenues and direct costs, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin improves slightly in 2025, aided by cost reductions and rate increases.
kpis.signal: Gross margin modestly improving due to operational efficiencies.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenues.
kpis.description: Operating margin improves in 2025, supported by favorable regulatory decisions.
kpis.signal: Operating margin rising due to stable regulated revenues and cost savings.

kpis.name: R&D Investments
kpis.explanation: Spending on research and development relative to revenues.
kpis.description: R&D spending is minimal, focused on energy efficiency and smart grids.
kpis.signal: R&D very low, typical for a utility, no major product innovation.

kpis.name: Share of AI data center-related projects
kpis.explanation: Percentage of new connections and projects related to powering data centers used for AI.
kpis.description: AEP identifies strong growth in electricity demand from AI-dedicated data centers.
kpis.signal: Nearly half of new connections are AI-related, a strong signal of sector transformation.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Investments in electrical infrastructure to meet demand from AI data centers and large customers.
kpis.description: AEP is investing heavily to modernize its grid and meet growing demand from data centers.
kpis.signal: Capex rising sharply, supported by demand from AI data centers.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned multiple times in the document, particularly regarding return on investment rates and cost recovery. The intensity of the language used underscores the importance of this risk.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions risks related to the company's ability to secure financing for its projects, particularly concerning capital costs and interest rates.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The document does not explicitly mention cybersecurity risks, but energy companies are often targeted by cyberattacks.

risks.title: Competition Risk
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions risks related to competition in the energy sector, particularly regarding production costs and selling prices.

risks.title: Nuclear Risk
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions risks related to nuclear power generation, particularly concerning nuclear incidents and decommissioning costs.

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions risks related to the company's reputation, particularly concerning criticism and controversies related to its operations.

risks.title: Environmental Regulation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions risks related to environmental regulation, particularly concerning compliance costs and fines.

risks.title: Technology Risk
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions risks related to technology, particularly concerning upgrade costs and depreciation risks.

risks.title: Investment Plan Execution Risk
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly states that 'AEP's capital investment plans are subject to execution risks' regarding the construction of new projects.

evidence: Risk Factors: 'Much of this demand is driven by interconnecting with and providing power to data centers and other large load customers to serve an increasingly digital economy and to support AI.'
